info.album: That's The Way Of The World

podcast.body: Featured on the album *That's the Way of the World*, this song became Earth, Wind & Fire's first number-one hit, propelling them to superstardom. "Good thing, because you know a little song from that album became their first number one, Shining Star, and Earth Wind and Fire, they were on their way to Super Stardom."

The lead single from *That's the Way of the World*, this song topped the Hot 100 a week after its parent album hit number one. Characterized by its percolating and danceable rhythm and mystically-minded lyrics about being a "manchild of the sun," "Shining Star" is considered the quintessential Earth Wind & Fire funk song, featuring both a heavy bottom and a pillowy top. "Shining star was the lead single of, that's the way of the world."
